name: 8hats
description: 8Hats public plugin marketplace — agent identity and continuity tooling. Each capability is a remote MCP server plus an npm-packaged local companion, so hosts that are not Claude Code can consume the same thing through the npm installer or by pointing at the endpoint directly.

plugins.description: Agent University BIOS and worldmodel plugin: OAuth-backed remote implant MCP plus a local companion MCP for exact-folder binding, one-use setup activation, last-good BIOS staging, and health checks.
